evidence_quotes.O: The polarizer glass in this filter is questionable quality and can cause distortion or glare.
evidence_quotes.C: Controls are easy to use (but read the instructions because the volume and music controls use the same buttons).
evidence_quotes.E: I like the small size of this bag for long walks around town.
evidence_quotes.A: The rest of the included accessories are garbage and I'll probably discard them.
evidence_quotes.N: I really hate it when cheaper heads droop a little after you've composed your scene, then you have to start all over again.
